t: How to Have a Beautiful Garden in Full Sun
s: When choosing plants to fill your full-sun garden, keep two concerns in mind: the plant's hardiness zones and its minimum daily sun requirement. Hardiness zone ratings found in catalogs and on plants tags usually have a lower and upper zone listed. The lower zone reflects the coldest winter temperatures the plant can take, while the upper limit reflects the warmest areas where it will thrive. Warm climates and intense sunlight often go hand in hand, so geography makes a difference.
